Package org.apache.juneau.http.classic

Class BasicStatusLine

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.http.classic.BasicStatusLine
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatusLine
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable
public class BasicStatusLine extends Object implements StatusLine
A basic implementation of the StatusLine interface.

Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested Unmodifiable snapshot" paradigm: every mutator routes through the single protected modify(Runnable) choke-point, and unmodifiable() returns a point-in-time snapshot of type BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable whose modify(...) override throws.

    • unmodifiable

      public BasicStatusLine unmodifiable()
      Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of this bean.

      The returned instance is a point-in-time copy of type BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable; any attempt to set a property on it throws an UnsupportedOperationException. This method is idempotent: if this bean is already unmodifiable it returns itself rather than taking another snapshot. The receiver is left unchanged (and still modifiable unless it was already an BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable).

      Returns:
      An unmodifiable snapshot of this bean, or this bean if it is already unmodifiable.

      protected BasicStatusLine modify(Runnable mutation)
      Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.

      Every mutator routes through this method. The BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable snapshot overrides only this method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override.

      Parameters:
      mutation - The state change to apply.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • freeze

      protected void freeze()
      Deep-freeze hook invoked from the BasicStatusLine.Unmodifiable constructor after the snapshot copy completes.

      This is a no-op for BasicStatusLine: all of its fields are immutable value types (protocol version, status code, reason phrase, locale, reason-phrase catalog) with no mutable sub-beans to deep-freeze. It exists as the paradigm's override point for families whose beans hold mutable sub-beans, which must be frozen here by direct field assignment (never via a setter, which would route through the throwing modify(Runnable)).
